blurb: Guests can rent pontoon boats for a day of water fun or stay in lakefront or lakeview cabins with free boat slips. The marina offers boat service, repairs, a ship's store, fuel, and a seasonal restaurant. The lake features 65 miles of undeveloped shoreline and 3,200 acres of deep, clear water.

quotes.author: Grace Z. Feb 2024
quotes.text: We love coming to stay at the cabins at Carter’s Lake. The staff is very friendly and helpful and the cabins are always so clean and cozy. The lake and mountains are beautiful any time of year! Unlike many rental cabins in north GA, the road is completely paved all the way to the cabin and there is plenty of parking for your cars and boat. You get all the benefits of a secluded cabin and can still use the marina and are close to hiking and fishing areas. It’s also convenient to Jasper or Ellijay.

quotes.author: Koondogs68 June 2022
quotes.text: Spent the weekend at Carter's Lake Marina, cabin 2. 3rd year of an annual boat trip with friends. Great hosts, pretty views over the lake from the back deck. Thanks to Denise and her co-workers, we will be back for year 4!! Make sure you drive and take in the beautiful view from atop the damn, looking down. A marvel of man's ingenuity!!

quotes.author: Kim J. August 2023
quotes.text: Amazing time on the lake! We rented the pontoon with water slide and the boat was very clean and well kept. Views were fantastic. Water was clean and beautiful! Staff was great also. Cannot say enough great things about this day. Our family had such a great time! Definitely one of my favorite days of our trip

quotes.author: Michael C. June 2018
quotes.text: Quaint, out of the way marina and cabins. Well off the beaten path and surrounded by nature. Well worth the visit and stay. Beautiful area of NGA at the tip of the Blue Ridge Mountains. Staff is top notch, friendly and helpful. Great place for a weekend getaway or a vacation for nature lovers.

quotes.author: Emily J. Jun 2023
quotes.text: Easy check in and fully equip kitchen! This peaceful spot was perfect for a 2 day get away! Denise was awesome and accommodating, she was so helpful with renting a boat and helping with booking! Highly recommended place! The lake was so clean and was perfect for swimming!

The Experience couldn't have gone any better! I rented a cabin and a boat both were immaculate and the boat was almost brand new. Denise was incredible and worked with us on a rainy day to ensure we received our full time on the boat. Highly recommend this place.
